# monotaur_secret (Resource)

Manages a Monotaur secret. Secrets are named key-value pairs (with a sensitive value) that can optionally be associated with a monitor.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "monotaur_secret" "webhook_token" {
  name        = "webhook_signing_token"
  value       = var.webhook_token
  description = "HMAC token used to verify incoming webhook payloads"
}

variable "webhook_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the secret.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The secret value. Sensitive and write-only: not returned by the API on read; the value set at create/update time is retained in Terraform state.

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description of the secret.
- `monitor_id` (String) The ID of the monitor this secret belongs to (optional).

### Read-Only

- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the secret was created (assigned by the API).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the secret (assigned by the API).
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the secret was last updated (assigned by the API).
